verification_report.summary: Both frozen follow-ups are correct relative to the explicitly accepted internal inputs. The Lp corollary correctly identifies the bounded equation scalar with b_omega(f), identifies the normalized continuous solution with the unique normalized threshold solution, and upgrades uniform precompactness plus unique clusters to whole-family uniform convergence. The projective square-map example has the stated ddc normalization, Stokes normalization, threshold calculation, all-current dual saturation, local density factor 2^n, root nondifferentiability (including n=2), and exclusion of a smooth strictly positive maximizer. No external paper theorem is used.
